text:
One night in Hakone without a car: we priced the same Wednesday in three bases. Yumoto ¥16,800, Gora ¥18,540, Lake Ashi ¥18,225. The price barely differs; your arrival time decides 👇

🍱 Hungry yet? The spots, times and prices 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-base-yumoto-gora-lake-ashi

🚉 A · HAKONE-YUMOTO

🧳 The Romancecar ends here, and our sample hotel is 150 m from the platform. ¥16,800 for two, room only, check-in until 23:30.

🔥 The only base with dinner on foot late: a charcoal grill 2 minutes from the station, last orders 21:30 (closed Mondays).

⛰️ B · GORA

🗿 One stop from the Open-Air Museum, and the cable car and ropeway start here.

🏨 Our sample hotel is 100 m from Gora Station, ¥18,540 with breakfast. Check-in until 20:00.

🚧 From 7 to 24 Dec 2026, the Owakudani–Sounzan ropeway section runs as a bus, about every 15 minutes.

🌊 C · LAKE ASHI

🌅 A lake-view double with breakfast, ¥18,225, 300 m from Moto-Hakone. Hakone Shrine is about 10 minutes from its bus stop.

🕗 But the last weekday bus up from Yumoto leaves at 20:48, and the latest lakeside last order we found is 19:00.

💭 What decides it is not the price, it's the clock. A late train makes Yumoto the easy, warm choice; a slow afternoon arrival makes the lake worth every minute of the bus ride up.

✅ OUR TAKE

Arriving after about 17:00 or leaving early: Yumoto. Museum or ropeway day, in by 18:00: Gora. At the lake by mid-afternoon: Lake Ashi.

👉 Breakfast with your feet in a lakeside onsen, plus all three bases:
